note: Supporters, added with their consent. The website (homepage, /thanks, /promote), the README (scripts/update-sponsors-readme.py, incl. the All Contributors table) and the app's About dialog all read this file. sponsors: name, since (YYYY-MM), optional github (username, for the README avatar) and url. promoters: name, since, platform, url (the piece itself), optional ref (their ?ref= code), github, featured + quote (shown on the homepage). testers: name, since, contribution {en, zh} — people who test SoloMD carefully and send detailed bug reports and analysis; optional github.

promoters.name: lcfactorization
promoters.quote: SoloMD已完全替代Typora等、且更优雅！

contribution.en: Systematic testing of the Windows editors, shortcuts, menus and toolbar, with detailed bug reports and analysis behind many fixes in 4.14.6–5.0.2.
contribution.zh: 系统地测试了 Windows 编辑器、快捷键、菜单和工具栏，提交了大量详细的问题报告和分析，4.14.6–5.0.2 版本的许多修复都来自他的测试。

contribution.en: Deep testing and detailed user experience feedback on file tree navigation, workspace handling, table editor, and shortcuts for 4.14.x through 5.0.2.
contribution.zh: 深度测试了文件树导航、工作区管理、表格编辑器及快捷键交互，为 4.14.x 到 5.0.2 提交了大量详尽的问题报告与改进建议。

contribution.en: Extensive custom theme and plugin experimentation on Windows, with detailed feedback on live preview rendering, tab management, and developer tooling.
contribution.zh: 在 Windows 端进行了深入的自定义主题与扩展实践，针对实时预览渲染、多标签页管理及开发者调试工具提出了详尽的改进建议。
